comment: the animation still sucks, to laggy and goes the wrong way, make the toolbar grip the center of movement, so the menu will rotate to the left and the toolbar grip will always be at the buttom in one flawless motion
actionLog: PR #107: moved the toolbar grip to be the LAST child so it sits next to the toolbar-wrap's fixed right/bottom anchor corner in both orientations (previously it was the first child, i.e. at whichever end is farthest from that anchor), removing the need for the old width-delta nudgePos compensation entirely; scoped the orientation-flip crossfade to the menu items only so the grip itself stays visible and still throughout.
